mapper.select: WITH yearly AS ( SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM monthly.period)::INT AS fire_year, SUM(monthly.harmonized) AS harmonized, SUM(monthly.low) AS low, SUM(monthly.high) AS high, SUM(monthly.harmonized_frp) AS harmonized_frp, COUNT(monthly.harmonized_frp) AS frp_months, SUM(monthly.modis_n) AS raw_modis, SUM(monthly.viirs_n) AS raw_viirs, COUNT(*) AS months FROM fire_monthly(ST_MakeEnvelope(#{west}, #{south}, #{east}, #{north}, 4326), #{through}) monthly GROUP BY 1 ) SELECT fire_year AS "year", harmonized, low, high, months = 12 AND NOT ( fire_year = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM #{through}::DATE) AND to_char(#{through}::DATE, 'MM-DD') <> '12-31' ) AS complete, harmonized_frp, CASE WHEN harmonized >= 1 THEN harmonized_frp / harmonized END AS mw_per_detection, raw_modis, raw_viirs FROM yearly ORDER BY fire_year

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM monthly.period)) FROM fire_monthly(ST_MakeEnvelope(#{west}, #{south}, #{east}, #{north}, 4326), #{through}) monthly WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM monthly.period) BETWEEN 2001 AND 2025 AND monthly.harmonized >= GREATEST(3 * COALESCE(monthly.normal, 0), 5)

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM monthly.period) FROM fire_monthly(ST_MakeEnvelope(#{west}, #{south}, #{east}, #{north}, 4326), #{through}) monthly WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM monthly.period) BETWEEN 2001 AND 2025 GROUP BY 1 HAVING SUM(monthly.harmonized) >= 1 ) years

SELECT to_char(monthly.period, 'YYYY-MM') AS period, monthly.harmonized, monthly.harmonized / NULLIF(monthly.normal, 0) AS times_normal FROM fire_monthly(ST_MakeEnvelope(#{west}, #{south}, #{east}, #{north}, 4326), #{through}) monthly WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM monthly.period) BETWEEN 2001 AND 2025 AND monthly.harmonized > 0 ORDER BY monthly.harmonized DESC, monthly.period LIMIT 3

WITH monthly_means AS ( SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM monthly.period)::INT AS calendar_month, AVG(monthly.harmonized) AS mean FROM fire_monthly(ST_MakeEnvelope(#{west}, #{south}, #{east}, #{north}, 4326), #{through}) monthly WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM monthly.period) BETWEEN 2003 AND 2023 GROUP BY 1 ) SELECT calendar_month AS "month", mean, COALESCE(mean / NULLIF(SUM(mean) OVER (), 0), 0) AS share, COALESCE(mean / NULLIF(SUM(mean) OVER (), 0), 0) >= 1.5 / 12 AS high_risk FROM monthly_means ORDER BY calendar_month

WITH center_point AS ( SELECT ST_Centroid(ST_MakeEnvelope(#{west}, #{south}, #{east}, #{north}, 4326))::GEOGRAPHY AS location, ST_MakeEnvelope(#{west}, #{south}, #{east}, #{north}, 4326) AS boundary ), distances AS ( SELECT fire.id, fire.latitude, fire.longitude, fire.frp, fire.sensor, fire.confidence_level, fire.acq_datetime_kst AS observed_at, ST_Distance(fire.location::GEOGRAPHY, center_point.location) / 1000 AS distance_km FROM fire_points fire CROSS JOIN center_point WHERE fire.acq_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} AND fire.location && center_point.boundary AND ST_Covers(center_point.boundary, fire.location) ) SELECT id, latitude, longitude, distance_km, frp, sensor, confidence_level, observed_at, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE distance_km <= 1) OVER () AS within_1_km, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE distance_km <= 5) OVER () AS within_5_km, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE distance_km <= 10) OVER () AS within_10_km FROM distances ORDER BY distance_km LIMIT 1
